messages:
olivia: Quick announcement — the release train will enter a 48h code freeze for prod cutover starting Thu Dec 03 00:00 UTC and ending Fri Dec 05 00:00 UTC. Please avoid non-critical merges to main during that window.

maria: Ack. Which PRs are still allowed (docs/typos/etc)?

olivia: Docs and tiny typo fixes that are only in the website repo are fine. For anything touching runtime, infer-service, or infra we need an exemption request. Ping #release-candidates with rationale and a reviewer.

alex: Are canary rollouts still OK during the freeze (small traffic %)?

olivia: Yes — canaries for already-approved changes are OK. No new schema migrations or model swaps unless approved by @jia.

jia: I can approve minor canary ops but will need a runbook. If you plan a model variant swap, add a rollback plan and a perf baseline.

kyle: Changelog reminder — I'll produce the weekly changelog tomorrow morning. Any final PRs that must land before freeze, post them here now.

sam: Putting these high-priority PRs up for visibility: #4218 (kv-cache bugfix), #4292 (batching perf tweak), #4301 (dedicated routing fallback). All have reviews.

olivia: Thanks @sam. For quick backports/cherry-picks, use this pattern:

```bash
git checkout -b backport/<pr>-release-v1.8
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
ci/bootstrap --skip-integration-tests
```

olivia: Don't skip integration tests unless you open an exemption in #release-candidates and tag @kyle for visibility.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: release-freeze window registered for team=eng, start=1763260800, end=1763433600. Notifying relevant channels.

kyle: I'll also publish a small note in the console changelog with the callouts: KV cache fix, batching improvements, fallback routing. Will include perf numbers once CI finishes.

maria: Quick question — will the Dedicated capacity autoscaler be disabled during the cutover?

olivia: We will put dynamic autoscaling into conservative mode (no aggressive scale-ups) for the 48h window. Ops to monitor. @sam can you coordinate with infra to set the policy?

sam: On it, will post the policy diff and rollout time by EOD.

olivia: Great — final checklist will go out Monday. If you need emergency deploys during the window, follow the emergency deploy playbook and escalate to oncall. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
